payload.title: Audit cleanup (low priority): Markus
payload.description:
**Problem**
Low-severity findings from the 2026-10-20 audit of Markus.

**Evidence / Fix** (one checklist line per finding)
- [ ] README directive table is missing about 15 directives that exist in the implementation; add them (the feature index on the docs site is the reference).
- [ ] The site footer's anth.us/blog link redirects to /articles; update it (the footer is shared, see the footer issue and AnthusAI/anthus-footer).

**How to verify**
Every directive registered in the parser appears in the README table; `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://anth.us/blog` no longer redirects once the footer link is updated.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
